description: Pins where a note's body starts, after the frontmatter's closing line: python-frontmatter's rule (what ingest uses), written out in cli/schist/ingest.py note_body_offset and mcp-server/src/markdown-parser.ts frontmatterLength. Connection parsing reads `body`; writers and the delete cascade skip the frontmatter lines before it. `python_whitespace` is str.isspace() (Python's strip() and re \s), which both implementations carry as a constant. Consumed by cli/tests/test_ingest.py and mcp-server/tests/frontmatter-boundary-parity.test.ts.
